The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their large [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] frames featuring [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] on their heads, [[Limb/Legends|forearms]] and hands, as well as feet, with a trio of large red [[Claw/Legends|claws]] extending from each of their appendages. They also possessed upturned [[Nose/Legends|noses]] and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="The Lost Prince" />

One member of this species, [[Yorpo Mog]], worked for [[Kleb Zellock]] as a part of his [[Kleb Zellock's criminal empire|criminal empire]]<ref name="The Lost Prince" /> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> while another served as a slave rower aboard [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]]'s [[Koong Navy|naval]] [[Boat/Legends|vessel]], the ''[[Roon Clipper]]'', on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]<ref name="Across the Roon Sea">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref> that same year.<ref name="Date" />
